title: Medi-Cal Certified Eligible Counts by Month of Eligibility, Zip Code, and Sex - Calendar Years 2020 to the Most Recent Reportable Month
publisher: California DHCS, Enterprise Data and Information Management / Data Management and Analytics Division (via CHHS Open Data Portal)
download_url: https://data.chhs.ca.gov/dataset/2065f24c-237c-426f-853b-a8c307d557a9/resource/55391885-76d4-4fa1-9af8-74844386fc48/download/oct2026_productionsecondsheet_2020_recent.csv (resolved at run time via CKAN package_show)
geo_coverage: California statewide, by residential 5-digit ZIP (about 2,530-2,570 ZIP rows per month incl. the two special values below) plus rows ZIP='.' (invalid/out-of-state) and 'STATEWIDE'. NO county column.
latest_observation: 2026-10 (preliminary, snapshot dated 07OCT2026). Aug 2026 and Sep 2026 present, also preliminary. Latest FINAL month: 2025-09
file_type: CSV (UTF-8, quoted thousands separators in counts)
granularity: month x ZIP x sex (Female, Male, Total)
privacy_limits: Cell suppression: Annotation Code 1 (small number) and 2 (complementary cell); suppressed counts are blank, NOT zero. 164,732 + 5,103 suppressed rows statewide. All Medi-Cal certified eligibles, not IEHP members.
license: Not stated in CKAN metadata (license_id null). CHHS Open Data Portal public-sector data; check dataset page terms [UNVERIFIED]
suitability: Primary demand denominator by ZIP for ALL Medi-Cal certified eligibles (managed care + FFS + other plans, e.g. Molina, Kaiser). Not suitable as IEHP-member or 'transitioning member' count without a stated assumption.
known_biases: Preliminary (status P) for the 12 most recent months; DHCS says a month is final 12 months after month end. Includes persons with full-scope expansion, so it is NOT a measure of any single population subgroup.
joins: zip (text, 5 chars) -> E zip5, F Billing Provider Zip, RUCA ZIPCode; zip ~ ZCTA via Census rel2020 (H) for ACS/PLACES/TIGER (ZIP != ZCTA). County must come from crosswalk.
reliability: High for counts; Medium for latest 12 months (preliminary)
